children: Reserve Rights opens the first burn gauge vote, letting RSR holders decide how tightly token unlocking is tied to protocol burn. The options range from High Burn, which introduces no new supply, to High Growth, where one burned RSR unlocks four.

The vote gives holders a direct decision point on RSR's supply path. The chosen ratio determines how much new issuance enters circulation as unlocks occur, so the outcome shapes the token's issuance schedule in the near term. Because this is the first gauge vote, the result also establishes a precedent for how future unlock-to-burn settings are decided. Participation levels and the winning setting will show how the community weighs scarcity against growth.
unlocking votes have been tallied, and The Burn Gauge wins 🔥
This means that moving forward, unlocking will be tied to protocol burn via a “gauge” set by RSR holders quarterly
